sources.title: The Precision-Recall Plot Is More Informative than the ROC Plot When Evaluating Binary Classifiers on Imbalanced Datasets
sources.depth: Publisher metadata/abstract, introduction on train/final-evaluation distinction, selected theoretical precision and prevalence discussion, text lines 134-159 and 211-229. Not a full-paper review or replication.
sources.support: Precision and PR behavior depend on class distribution; accuracy/ROC interpretation can conceal rare-positive burden.
sources.transfer_limit: Biological classifier examples do not estimate financial prevalence, Project 50K alert precision or its deployment rates.

sources.title: On the Foundations of Noise-free Selective Classification
sources.depth: Publisher metadata and abstract only, lines 30-35. No theorem reviewed or applied.
sources.support: Reject-option classification treats risk and coverage as a tradeoff.
sources.transfer_limit: The stated theory assumes noise-free models and provides no project guarantee for abstention or noisy evidence.

sources.title: Towards a Rigorous Evaluation of Time-Series Anomaly Detection
sources.depth: Publisher metadata and abstract only in this risk task, lines 18-44. The project's evaluation lab documents its separate selected-PDF review. No benchmark replication here.
sources.support: Point adjustment can overestimate time-series anomaly performance and alter method rankings, including random/untrained baselines.
sources.transfer_limit: The paper does not establish financial detection, event usefulness or loss prevention for this product.

sources.title: Estimated Net Cash Flow Methodology
sources.depth: All three extracted pages read across two selected opens; distributions/reinvestment, fund/class approximation, inception/merger and US ETF context inspected. No current implementation verification.
sources.support: Published flow methodology is an estimate with explicit distribution, reinvestment, share-class and merger conventions.
sources.transfer_limit: Historical foreign conventions do not establish Turkish defaults, exact sparse-endpoint transaction cash or provider entitlement. The fund lab's counterexamples establish its narrower non-identification claim independently.

sources.depth: Selected discussion/Broader Impact reopened in this risk task, PDF pp. 9-10 / lines 528-553. Metadata previously verified in the same session. Not a full-paper review.
sources.support: External knowledge can itself be wrong or biased; retrieval is not a world-truth guarantee.
sources.transfer_limit: No project hallucination, citation entailment or causal accuracy is inferred from its NLP comparisons.
